missing_sequence: Use receive_time_utc then event_id within equal event_time and source; sequence gaps are unobservable
out_of_order_or_late: Replay batches are canonically sorted then chronology-checked; live streams reject event-time regression or non-increasing source sequence and require replay
multi_source_tie: For equal event_time, lexicographic source order precedes source-local sequence ordering
causality_claim: No cross-source causal order is inferred; source tie-break is deterministic replay convention only
recovery: Rebuild from an authoritative source snapshot or replay before resuming the affected stream
